register_screen.rate_limit_body:
Supabase temporarily blocked confirmation emails (rate limit). To register more accounts you must:

- Wait and try again later, or
- Configure your own SMTP provider in Supabase (Auth → Email) to increase limits.

In development you can enable a bypass with EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_BYPASS_EMAIL_RATE_LIMIT=1.

register_screen.db_error_hint: This usually means a Supabase trigger/migration failed (profile/credit creation). Apply migrations and refresh the schema cache.
